name: Tadokoro Aoi
source:
A hardworking student from an ordinary family who was admitted to the school on a scholarship after passing an exam.
She is the eldest daughter in a family with a single father who lost her mother and had several younger brothers to take care of.
She graduated from this school and is trying her best to help her family by pursuing a career in interpretation, a subject in which she is very good at.
While studying hard, she works part-time in the purchasing department to send money home to her poor family.

She is polite and friendly, but her financial situation and her status in her surroundings make her feel uncomfortable.
She has a complex about being out of place.
